sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVICE (EXECUTIVE BRANCH) RULES, 1984
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVICE (EXECUTIVE BRANCH) RULES,
1984
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary,
13th December, 2016]
No.
S.O (R-II)(22)48 / 2016-S&GAD / 4358-79, dated 13.12.2016.---In exercise of powers conferred by section 25 of
the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No.IX of 1974), the Government of
Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendments in the Balochistan
Civil Service (Executive Branch) Rules, 1984, namely:--
In
the aforesaid rules:-
(a) in
rule 5 in sub-rule (4), for clause (b), the following shall be substituted:-
(b)
"as and when the post becomes available to be filled by promotion under
clause (b) of sub-rule (3), the same shall be circulated for inviting
applications to be received within 15 days of the date of circular letter from
amongst the following categories of employees, who possesses Bachelor's Degree
and holds substantive post of BPS-17 and BPS-16 having at least three (3) years
service as such. Upon receipt of applications the S&GAD shall prepare a
Select List "B" in accordance with the Form 2 appended to these
rules, within one (1) month of the last date of application:-
(i) Balochistan
Secretariat Service and Board of Revenue.
(1) Private
Secretaries (BPS-17);
(2) Superintendents
(BPS-17); and
(3) Assistant
Private Secretaries (BPS-16); and
(ii) Commissioner's
Offices.
(1) Private
Secretaries (BPS-17);
(2) Superintendents
(BPS-17); and
(3) Assistant
Private Secretaries (BPS-16); and
Explanation:
The
promotion against ministerial quota from the above mentioned Select List
"B" shall be made on merit-cum-fitness basis/PERs synopsis and
ability to hold the higher post. The applicants will have to provide their
C.Vs/Bio-data and regular promotion Notifications along with their
applications."
(b) for
rule 6, the following shall be substituted:-
"6.
Age.---No person, who is less than 21 years or more than 28 years
of age shall be appointed to the Service by initial recruitment:
Provided
that only the upper age limit may be relaxed in terms of rule 4 of the
Balochistan Government Initial Appointment to Civil Service Posts (Age and
Relaxation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 2012."
